title: Data Validation and Normalization
learning_outcomes: Describe the purpose of Data Validation and Normalization and define its core vocabulary.

content.intro: This lesson covers Data Validation and Normalization in the PowerShell learning path. It expands the supplied syllabus heading into an actionable draft with a visual, a worked example, and a short knowledge check.
content.why_it_matters: Make data types and control flow explicit. Inspect values at boundaries, prefer readable comparisons and parenthesized expressions, normalize input before transforming it, and test empty collections, null values and other boundary cases before relying on the result.
